name: governance
about: Open governance. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 governance/src/lib.rs:300-570 — there is no control to create a proposal: propose cannot be walked
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 governance/src/lib.rs:543-566 — Approve / Reject show for validators only and the walk joins as a member node: a vote needs a validator rig
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 governance — no you-voted state: after a vote only the tally changes

steps.say: open the Governance tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Governance tab is selected and the governance view shows its proposals or an empty state (a member that is not a validator sees that only this network's validators vote); no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
